answer: The nectar index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the ferrous queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 268 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the whisper. A farm of 232 pays that 240 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
